summary: The Causeway Region was once a ceremonial Dragorn noble passage, now a fortified war corridor linking Dranik’s Scar to the Wall of Slaughter.
history: Dragorn artisans constructed the causeway terraces as noble procession routes.
Shrines and ridge‑altars were erected to honor Dragorn lineage.
Muramite forces invaded, destroying shrines and fortifying the valley.
Discord fissures erupted across the ridge, corrupting stone and statues.
Dragorn resistance cells now use the terraces for sabotage and ambush.
